decision_rule.bundle: M4/M10 budget cap as selection pressure: bundle budget B = max(1, ceil(B0 * ANNEAL^t)), B0=3, ANNEAL=0.7, t=prior_e6_slices=1 → B = ceil(2.1) = 3. Bundle = certified QRNG lead + (B-1) top-noul fills (noul desc, arm-index tie-break). ONLY bundle arms are measured; the other 5 arms stay frozen-unmeasured (never peeked).
decision_rule.anti_cherry_pick: the priors NEVER choose what gets measured — the binding lead is a certified comet-qrng-v1 draw over the frozen 8-arm list; the LLM choice is receipted as a reflective prior only. THE FIRST CERTIFIED SEAL BINDS: no re-draw after a seal for any reason (moth-seal's singleUse seed law); draw-ladder retries exist only for channel failure BEFORE any seal, and every attempt is ledgered.
decision_rule.margin_note: 0.05 relative chosen a priori (unchanged from slice-1, which chose it before any arm measurement), paired with a hard no-recall-collapse floor (totalF >= 15) so precision cannot be bought with recall
decision_rule.fail_branch: if no measured bundle arm meets both conditions: seal FAIL verbatim in receipts/decide.json + verdict.md — no threshold surgery, no post-hoc metric revision, unmeasured arms stay frozen; failure_mode and next_probe named
decision_rule.boring_branch: if the gate fails only because arms are metric-inert (M equal to baseline within the margin AND totalF unchanged), the FAIL verdict additionally records mutation_space_inert: true

cost_rule.law: M10 (arXiv:2609.24972): added inference cost must be paid for by measured gain on the target
added_spend: ZERO typesafe calls — the slice-1 sealed reflective priors of record are REUSED (see priors_source below; registered choice, reasoning receipted)
mothquantum comet-qrng-v1 jobs as consumed by the registered draw ladder (see cap below); each attempt append-only ledgered in receipts/qrng-attempts.jsonl + receipts/usage.jsonl

caps.moth_jobs_cap_note: CAP REGISTERED IN JOBS, NOT SEALS — wave-62 lesson (slice-1 consumed 2 jobs with ZERO seals issued; seals-issued accounting silently under-counts channel degradation). The draw ladder may consume at most 3 comet jobs total in this slice; it stops at the first certified seal or when the job cap is consumed, whichever comes first.

cost_rule.draw_ladder: registered before any draw: attempt 1 stream=direct (certified bytes consumed directly; feasible now that the channel delivers ~1136 extracted bits/job vs the 112 needed for pool 8); on any fail-closed, attempt 2 stream=prf (moth-seal's own registered extension: certified bytes seed the SHA-256 counter stream, effectiveEntropyBits declared in the receipt); on any fail-closed, attempt 3 stream=prf; then stop. Every attempt ledgered with job_consumed accounting (any fail-closed after submit consumed a job; local pre-submit failures consumed nothing). No stream choice is made post-hoc — this ladder IS the registration.
cost_rule.settlement: spend is PAID iff the verdict is PASS (a measured-better KEYS variant exists from the bundle); on FAIL or honest partial the receipt records NOT_PAID — the added spend bought an honest negative, not gain
